purpose: Provide complete selected game resources through a lazy byte-range file port on browser and wx,independently of updater package processing.

observed_problem.updater_archive: 64 entries and32MiB input/output;the former game Page reused this whole-memory decoder and1024-file patch candidates.
observed_problem.actual_material: 1071 Bin files totaling2547446075 bytes,plus the1569280-byte fixed client;largest bank943552437 bytes.
observed_problem.original_source_file_contract: The existing source-bound startup and resource library read cg_se_6000.exe and loose relative resource files through stat/read(offset,length).The new ZIP is an independent local transport adapter.

format.features: Single-disk ZIP/ZIP64,stored and raw Deflate,optional64-bit end records even with non-sentinel32-bit fields,32/64-bit descriptors with/without signatures,prefixes and comments.
format.directory: Read the footer and bounded central directory;retain metadata and validate local headers/descriptors on first file access.No whole package or whole stored bank is loaded.
format.integers: All positions and sizes use exact safe JavaScript integers;64-bit values combine two unsigned32-bit words.Neither archive offsets nor byte ranges are narrowed through bitwise operations.
format.root: An explicit rootPrefix takes priority;otherwise a unique source-defined cg_se_6000.exe path identifies the installation root.Packages without that module retain the archive root,so Bin is never arbitrarily stripped.UTF8 outer roots are supported;addressable game paths retain the existing relative ASCII contract.
format.CRC: Full stored-entry reads verify CRC.Partial stored reads provide exact checked ranges like selected loose Files;they do not claim whole-entry CRC verification.Deflate scans to the end and verifies output length,input consumption and full CRC before returning a requested slice.

interfaces.input: createLegacyGameResourceArchive({size,read(offset,length),close()},options) takes ownership of an explicit selected range file,including initialization failure.
interfaces.output: {count,port:{stat(path),read(path,offset,length)},inspect(),close()} matches existing resource consumers.Returned bytes belong to the caller.Metadata,cache and late reads are cleared on closure.
interfaces.browser: createBrowserLegacyGameResourceArchive wraps File.slice().arrayBuffer();the game page offers folder or ZIP selection and clears the alternative.Provided resource ownership transfers to the existing browser client.
interfaces.wechat: The dedicated archive picker retains the selected native file and requests bounded FileSystemManager.readFile ranges.The existing JSON/launcher readers and updater behavior are preserved.
interfaces.packer: python3 tools/pack-game-resources.py --root GAME_ROOT --output NEW_ZIP [--receipt JSON] writes a deterministic stored ZIP/ZIP64 and per-file SHA manifest without modifying sources or overwriting an existing output.

engineering_budgets.large_Deflate: Larger entries are scanned with bounded buffers and are not retained whole.For large random-access graphic banks,the supplied stored packer avoids repeated cold Deflate scans.

acceptance: All1072 original packed files independently pass streaming SHA-256 and CRC verification.
Source and generated APIs compare3216 real material slices,read the complete fixed client and prepare v2 startup fields identically.
A sparse ZIP64 puts an actual marker after4GiB;bounded reads preserve its offset.
Actual Chromium desktop/touch and source/generated Node wx Page use2.55GB authored sparse ZIP64 packages containing all260 unique sound paths,then complete battle and movement.
Stored,Deflate and muted archive paths plus the existing folder flow remain separate acceptance cases.
remaining: Actual WeChat chooser/file-size/storage behavior,device resource reads and physical phone acceptance.
Large Deflate bank cold-read performance and prefixed ZIP64 extension sectors larger than the retained footer search window.
Resource-version compatibility,complete native application scheduling,remaining game consumers and current official handoff/account acceptance.
Original37 requirements and10 incomplete consumer groups remain intact.
